name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: The EZ-bar curl is a barbell curl variation using the angled cambered EZ-curl bar, which places the wrists in a semi-supinated position that reduces ulnar deviation stress compared to a straight bar. This grip positioning strongly activates the brachialis alongside the biceps brachii, and is often considered more joint-friendly for lifters who experience wrist or elbow discomfort with straight-bar curls.

execution.starting_position: Stand upright holding the EZ-bar using the inner angled grip, wrists in a semi-supinated (angled) position. Arms fully extended, bar at hip level.
execution.setup_instructions: Load the EZ-curl bar with appropriate weight. Grip the inner angled portion of the bar with both hands for the standard semi-supinated grip. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Step 1: Hold the EZ-bar at arm's length with the inner angled grip. Stand tall with the core braced.
Step 2: Keep the elbows pinned at the sides — they should not travel forward.
Step 3: Exhale and curl the bar upward in an arc until it reaches approximately shoulder level and the biceps are fully contracted.
Step 4: Inhale and lower the bar in a controlled arc back to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl up; inhale on the controlled lowering.
common_mistakes: Letting the elbows travel forward significantly as the bar rises, which recruits the anterior deltoid
Swinging the torso to generate momentum — the movement should be strict
safety_considerations: If wrist discomfort occurs with the inner grip, try the outer angled grip
Avoid hyperextending the elbows at the bottom of each rep
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension at the bottom; curl to full bicep contraction at the top.
coaching_cues: Elbows stay at your sides — curl the weight, do not swing it
Squeeze at the top before lowering slowly
